_comment: Spec §4.3 default weights for the ON-DEVICE / AUTHORING confidence score. These reproduce the original heuristic and are ILLUSTRATIVE STARTING VALUES, not empirically validated — tune against the NZ pilot. This config is loaded by the authoring build (dev-only) and re-colors the map live with no tile rebuild. The shipped build has NO confidence UI; it only reads the fixed curation config produced from this authoring loop.
